_comment: Season team photographs taken from each season's own roster page. Identification rests primarily on the page that publishes them; the jersey cross-check against archive.json is recorded per entry as supporting evidence, including where it disagrees. A file here supersedes the same key under teams/original/, which is never deleted, so the substitution stays auditable.

not_taken.team_2006_07: The roster page copy is 1368x872, smaller than the 1500x993 original this archive already holds. Taking it would lose detail that no upscaler can return, so 2006-07 continues to derive from teams/original/.

team_1997_98.verification: Exact: all 13 numbers in frame (3,4,5,11,13,14,15,21,22,25,33,34,42) match the 13-player roster, none missing, none extra.
team_1997_98.rights: Not cleared. Photograph is a University of Kentucky team portrait; this site is not the rights holder. Recorded for provenance only.

team_2000_01.identified_by: published on the official season roster page for this season
team_2000_01.verification: Discrepancy: 12 of 13 match. The frame shows a #40, which this archive does not record for 2000-01, and does not show the #42 (Jason Parker) that it does. Jules Camara wore #40 in 1999-00 and 2001-02 but is absent from this archive's 2000-01 roster. Identification rests on the season roster page that publishes it, not on the jersey set.
